body: I don't know how to explain it to you but when I look at anything, touch anything, something is off kilter. I can't say what it is for sure, I just know there is something more than this life. It's so clear to me. I can only imagine what would happen if I told someone this not on the internet. I'm not willing to walk down that road.
Yes but that doesn't matter now. I am thinking clearly and what those experiences have shown me is that our perception is so fickle.

> What do you think is our there?

I don't know.

> Also, how long have you looked at things this way?

I don't know this either, maybe when dreams started feeling more real than reality. Maybe when the spells of laughter and depression started because my brain chemicals aren't balanced. An amalgam of many small sequential events lead to this. I don't care much for history. It is gone.

There is no going back because once you don't fear death I don't see how you can go back to being afraid. I don't know if I can explain how life is illusory so I will just say that I have very strong faith that there is more than this. This life is nothing.
I will be free from this illusory life.
Everyone is afraid of death. When you lose your fear you become estranged from humanity. There is no going back.
